title: Seaweed Soup · Course 2
source: GGYC Manuel Fagundes Seaweed Soup Regatta 2026–27, Addendum B: Courses and Marks, Revision 1 (2026-11-05). Mark positions from YRA (github.com/nkiesel/YRA-Marks). Main sailing instructions not available.
notes: GGYC Seaweed Soup 2026–27, Addendum B. About 3.2 nm. Start westward off the GGYC race deck. Pass X on the side shown to keep clear of the line; it is not a rounding mark. Crossing the line mid-race is a two-turn penalty. Marks are at YRA positions; the line runs from the race deck out to X, an assumption to check against the sailing instructions.

committee.label: GGYC race deck
committee.verify: The line is not defined in Addendum B (it refers to the main SIs). Race deck to X is inferred: X is 'approximately 300 yards north of Golden Gate YC' (B2) and exists 'to keep boats out of the start/finish line mid-race' (footnote 1), which only works if X marks the line's outer end; the 2011–12 SIs reportedly used the race deck and X. Confirm against the 2026–27 SIs.

obstructions.note: Addendum B1.1: the start/finish line is an obstruction for boats not in their starting sequence or on their first or last leg; crossing it is a two-turn penalty (SI 7.x).
